tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ ched du brjod pa'i glu'i phreng ba khog dbub dang bcas pa utpala'i do shal lags/ 236)na mo ma hā gu ru ratna sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ srid zhi ma lus pa'i khyab bdag dkyil 'khor kun gtso rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmo lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan nyid la rnam kun tu phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ de yang theg pa'i yang snying gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i zab don ye shes kyi 'khor lo nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor dam pa rnams kyis rang byung ye shes don gyi dbyings las nyams rtogs ye shes kyi chu 'dzin 'khrig cing shugs 'byung rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'brug ltar 237)ldir bas zab mo chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char phabs nas nyams myong lhan skyes bde chen gyi pad tshal rgyas par byed pa'i mgur dbyangs kyi rim pa la/ mgur gyi ngo bo/ nges tshig dbye ba/ dgos ched/ phan yon dang lnga'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs par byed de/ de la ngo bo ni/ don dam spros bral chos nyid klong nas 'gag med rang gsal nyams myong gi me tog 'khrungs te/ bde stong ye shes kyi dri bsung phyogs bcur 'phro zhing*/ rtsa 'dabs 'khor lo lnga dang khyad par mgrin pa ro 'dus kyi 'khor lo'i lhun grub rtsa ba'i yi ge rnams rang byung ye shes kyi rlung gis bskul ba 238)la brten nas grags stong 'dzin med kyi sgra dbyangs su grags pa zhig yin la/ nges tshig ni/ gzhan gyi rna bar snyan cing rang nyid nyams rtogs spor byed kyi dbyangs su mgur gyi bum pa nas byung phyir mgur zhes ming du grags pa yin zhing*/ dbye na/ rang gzhan gyi blo kha chos la bsgyur ba skyo shas nges 'byung gi dbyangs dang*/ thugs rje byin rlabs gnad nas bskul byed gsol 'debs gdung dbyangs kyi mgur dang*/ nyams rtogs ye shes gong 'phel du byed pa gsal 'debs nyams kyi dbyangs dang*/

nyams len zab mo lam du khyer phyir bogs 'don slab bya snying gtam gyi mgur dang*/ bar chad sel zhing legs tshogs spel ba rten 'brel bkra shis smon lam gyi dbyangs dang lngar 'dus la/ dgos ched ni/ le lo can chos la bskul ba dang*/ dad pa can dag snang 'char/ brtson 'grus can legs lam 'dzud/ nyams myong can nges shes skye/ skyon mtshang 239)can 'gyod pa bskyed/ rang nyid nyams rtogs 'phel/ gzhan dag gi dang ba 'dren pa la sogs pa'i dgos ched bsam gyis mi khyab/ phan yon ni/ rang gzhan gyi dge tshogs 'phel/ yul gong ma rnams la mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur/ ma mkha' 'gro rnams mnyes shing tshim/ skye 'gro pha ma'i rang bzhin gyi tshogs la'ang chos kyi sbyin pa bla med du 'gyur/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes rtsol med du 'char bar byed pa'i thabs zab bla na med pa yin zhing*/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i skabs su ni glu dang bro gar la sogs spong bar gsungs kyang*/ 'di la yang*/ 'jig rten gyi glu gar spong bar gsungs pa yin gyi/ chos kyi ni spang bar ma gsungs te/ 'dul ba lung las/ chos kyi glu 'di ma shes par/ dben pa'i gnas su bslab par bya/ zhes gsungs so/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab rmad du byung ba nyams su 240)len pa'i rnal 'byor la ni cir snang dag pa rab 'byams gang shar ye shes kyi rnam rol spong len dgag bsgrub dang bral zhing sgo gsum sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin rang byung rang babs rang rig gi ngang du sgom med yengs med gnas lugs khyab gdal gyi klong nas rdo rje glu'i dkor mdzod zab don tshig gi phreng ba shugs 'byung rnams kyi rol gar mgur dbyangs rna ba'i bdud rtsi la dbang ba ni 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i rnal 'byor pa kho na'i khyad chos yin pas/ des na yul gong mar gyur pa skyabs gnas rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis steng gi nam mkhar thugs rje byin rlabs kyis sprin bstibs/

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs kyi bar snang gang zhing mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi glog stong 'khyug dam tshig mthun pa'i mched lcam gyi tshogs kyi sa gzhi gang bas nyams rtogs mos gus kyi mtsho chen brdol ba'i gnas 'dir/ rnal 'byor 241)rnams kyis glu dbyangs kyi mchod pa phul ba la thugs rje brtse ba'i dgongs pas gzigs shing ma bcos spros med bde chen ye shes chen po'i ngang nas gsan 'tshal// ༈ na moḥgu ru bhyaḥ dpal rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i rje// skyabs med dran chog bdag gi pha// dus de ring snying la lhangs kyi dran// khyed thugs rjes bzung dang rje btsun pa/ lus dal 'byor rin chen thob na yang*// pha 'dren mchog khyed dang ma phrad na// bdag dal 'byor don med de'u song byas// las ci byed kun byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra// rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin las// gzhi 'chugs med rgyal bstan sgo ru bcug /lam bla med smin grol gyi bang mdzod phogs// don dbyer med rang rig la phyag 'dzub gtsug /bdag 'di phyi'i bde skyid la gtsan sa zin// gnad ma nor zab khrid kyi gdams 242)ngag gi /gzhi ma bcos ka dag gi gnas lugs rtogs// 'phral kun rdzob 'khrul snang gi 'char sgo kun// don rang rig rang gsal gyi rol pa las// thabs dgag sgrub spong bsgyur la rag ma lus// gnad gang shar rang grol gdams ngag shes// bdag de phyir gtan don gyi mdun ma 'grub// yar sangs rgyas zhing khams kyi bde skyid dang*// mar 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi snang tshul kun/ don rang rig spros bral gyi 'char sgo la// rtogs ma rtogs khyad par gyis phyes pa tsam// don de phyir pha khyed bka' drin la// tshe bskal pa'i bar du 'khor thabs med// lus longs spyod gtan gyi 'dun ma kun// blo ltos med mchod pa'i maṇḍal du// dus 'di bzung gtan du 'bul lags na// bdag khams gsum sems can gyi tshogs rnams kun// rje khyed kyis g.yel med du gzigs nas kyang*// lam 'gyur

243)med byang chub la 'god du gsol/ bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i glu'o// ༈ e ma/ phyi rol snang srid kyi dngos po la phar bltas pas// snang ba kun rmi lam sgyu ma dang 'dra// sna tshogs kun snang yang snying pos dben// cir snang kun rang sems kyi rol pa nyid// 'gags med du 'char ba 'di rang re spro/ a la la/ rang byung ye shes rtogs pa'i ngo mtshar la/ a la la/ ma bcos chos sku mjal ba'i ya mtshan la// nang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo la tshur bltas pas// rang bzhin du gsal la ngo bos stong*// yod med dang yin min mtha' las 'das// rtag chad kyi mtshan ma ye nas bral// skye med du gnas pa 'di dang re spro/ a la la/ stong gsal 'dzin med rtogs pa'i ngo mtshar la/ a la la/ skye med rang rig mthong ba'i ya mtshan 244)la// rnam rtog 'gyu dran gyi rang ngo la cer bltas pas/ dran rtog kun chu dang rba rlabs 'dra// rang nyid las byung zhing rang sar thim// ngo shes tsam nyid nas rang grol ba// spang gnyen dang bral ba 'di dag re spro/ a la la/ shar grol dus mnyam rtogs pa'i ngo mtshar la/ a la la/ gang shar rang grol shes pa'i ya mtshan la// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// bdag nyid kyi dad pa'i gdung shugs kyi// nyams rtogs kun dbyar gyi rtsi thog bzhin// 'phel rgyas su 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ nang sems dbyer med la spro ba'i glu / rang sems kyi sangs rgyas 'jal ba 'di// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i bka' drin lags// drin lan du cir snang chos sku ru// lhun 'grub tu rtogs pa'i maṇḍal 'bul// 'gro drug gi sems can mtha' dag kun// drin can gyi pha ma'i rang bzhin nyid// drin lan du thar pa'i 245)sa bon 'debs// phan 'dogs kyi mchog de cis kyang byed// skyid 'dod kyi nga bdag 'gong po 'di// thar lam gyi gegs su lhag par che// gegs sel du gang byung lam khyer bas// cir shar la sgom gyi grogs su byed// bzang ngan gyi rtog tshogs bsam yas la// dgag sgrub kyi bcos mas ci zhig byed// bar chad kyi rtsa ba gces 'dzin yin// gces 'dzin ni gdos bcas lus kyis lan// sgyu lus 'di lha 'dre'i tshogs la sbyin// bar chad kyi yul gyis dben pa zhig bya// sangs rgyas zhes thob dang ma thob kyi// re dogs 'di 'khor ba'i gting rdo lags// ma thob kyang thob 'dod ci'i phyir byed// gtan 'dun kun bla ma'i thugs rje las// gang la yang dgag sgrub

246)mi bya'o// gdams pa nges shes bskyed pa'i glu'o// ༈ kye ma/ sngon tshe rabs mtha' med da lta'i bar// byas pa kun rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra// rmi lam snying pos dben chos la 'bungs// don de phyir dam pa'i chos la 'bod/ dus do nub tsam du'ang mi 'chi ba'i// gdeng blo gtad rdul tsam 'dug gam soms// nam 'chi cha med yin chos la 'bungs// tshe mi rtag soms la chos la 'bod// stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mnga' thang yang*// rang 'chi ba'i tshe na gcig pur 'gro// 'jig rten mig 'phrul 'dra'o chos la 'bungs// kun 'dor bar nges so chos la 'bod// nor rnam thos bu yi longs spyod kyang*// dpe sbrang mas bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi 'dra// 'chi dus khyer dbang med do chos la 'bungs// rdul tsam yang mi phan chos la 'bod// rje mtshan ldan bla ma brten byas nas// chos zab rgu'i 247)snying po ma blangs na// cis kyang phan par dka' chos la 'bungs// tshe phyi ma soms la chos la 'bod// 'phral ltar snang rnam rig bkra na yang*// sems rig pa'i rang mtshang ma rtogs na// shes los phan pa med do chos la 'bungs// don snying por dril cig skan ldan kun// chos la bskul ba'i glu'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ dag snang mos gus gting nas ma bskyed na// tshig gis gsol ba btab kyang dgos rgyu chung*// gdung shugs gus pa ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// ci smras gsol 'debs dbyangs su 'gyur ba lags// zhen log nges 'byung snying nas ma skyes na// bya ba btang los chos brgyad mgo mi snyom// cis kyang dgos med sems la shar ba na// snang srid thams cad rang gi mnga' 'bangs nyid// don gyi snying po rang sems ma rtogs na// thos pa che yang tshig gi sbun pa tsam// gcig shes kun 248)grol gnad gsang rig pa'i tshe// ri rgyal rtse nas gling bzhi mthong ba 'dra// phu thag sgro 'dogs sems la ma chod na// bshad pa'i tshig gis gnas lugs rtogs pa min// sgom byung shes rab nang nas shar ba'i tshe// kha bshad mkhan rnams ne tso'i 'don pa 'dra// rtse gcig snying rus chos la ma byas na// byas lo'i chos kyi sangs rgyas 'grub par dka'// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i sgom chen la// sangs rgyas go 'phang lag pa'i mthil na mchis// rang nyid mi bsgom gzhan don ltar snang 'di// gtsug lag khang gi dkor gnyer dmus long 'dra// sgom nyams mthar phyin drod rtags thob pa'i tshe// rang gzhan don kun lhun gyis 'grub pa lags/

gang shar rang babs kyi glu'o// ༈ mi nga yi bla ma rgyal dbang padma// dkyil 'khor kun gtso 'ja' tshon snying po// dran chog rgyal po gzhan phan rdo rje// deng 'dir gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje yis 249)gzigs dang*// ya gi mtho la yangs pa dgung sngon gyi mthon po// snang byed gsal la 'tsher ba khri gdugs kyi nyi zla// 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gyed pas gling bzhi'i mun sel// 'di yang 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams kyi mthu lags// sems nyid gdod nas dag pa stong chen gyi ka dag /dwangs gsal sgrib g.yogs med pa lhun grub kyi 'od gsal// rig rtsal 'gags medadu 'char ba kun khyab kyi rol pa// 'di yang sku gsum dbyer med rang chas su bzhugs lags// ris med yongs la khyab pa mkha' dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor// g.yu 'brug ldir dbyangs sgrog pa'i chu 'dzin gyi klong las// bdud rtsi'i char zil 'phreng ba yang yang du babs pas// lo 'bras 'bru drug smin pa skye 'gro yi dpal lags// drin can bla ma'i thugs rje phyogs ris dang bral yang*// gdung bas gsol 'debs la brtse chen gyis gzigs 250)pas/ smin grol bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bad med du 'bebs tshe// nyams rtogs myu gu 'khrungs pa bka' drin gyi mchog lags// dpal ldan rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mtshan ldan gyi bla ma// mos pas gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu 'bangs la gzigs nas// 'di bzung byang chub bar du 'bral med kyi thugs rjes// rtag tu g.yel med skyob cing byin gyis rang rlobs shig dpe don gyi glu'o// ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba kun dang*// dbyer med rigs kyi bdag po// drin can rje btsun mchog la// gus pas spyi bos 'dud do// pha khyod drin can gyis bskyangs pa'i// bu nga'i nyams kyi bde gzhas// chos kyi glu dbyangs cor cor 251)/dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul lags// de ring nyams kyi 'char sgo// bde chen rang sems ltad mo// sna tshogs mthong bas dga' ba// skyid pa'i bro brdung ldir yang*// a ho rig pa'i khye chung*// rtsod ldan bstan zhabs skyes kyang*// lam zab 'jug sgo ma nor// bsam zhing rang sems dga' bo// bstan pa'i rnam grangs mang kyang*// rtsod med snying po'i don la// yang dag thos bsam bsgom pas// rang drin rang la che byung*// nga bzang bla ma mang yang*// rgyal bas byin rlabs lung bstan// sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal 'dug

/'dis kyang blo sems bde'o// rigs rus bzang por rlom pa'i// rang gzhan gnyis phung bsgrub mkhan// bla ma'i zol dang ma phrad// 'dis kyang snang ba skyid 'dug /thos bsam byas yus chen pos// mkhas grangs lo 'dod ma byas// gtan don snying por dril shes// 'dun ma'i rtsa 252)ba legs byung*// mi tshe rmi lam tsam 'dir// tha snyad tshig skam ma bslab// sgrub la tshe mjug dril bas// skyid pa'i nyi ma shar byung*// 'khor ba'i khyim thabs spang shing*// zang zing nor phyir ma 'brangs// bya btang chos pa'i khyu ru// zhugs pas bsam pa 'grub byung*// dkor nag log 'tsho'i ched du// mi tshe grong 'khyams ma byas// dben gnas ri khrod bsnyegs pas// bar chad bdud dang bral song*// drin can bla ma ma gtogs/ mi chen ngo srung ma byas// mi chos khyu nas don pas// rang dbang rang gis thob 'dug /lha dang bla ma mnyes phyir// dam tshig ngos lkog med pas// mi gzhan su ma mgu yang*// 'gyod sems skad cig med do// sde ris phyogs 'dzin med pas// skyabs gnas dkon mchog bla ma// rgyab rten mkha' 'gro chos srung*// 'bral med nges shes rnyed byung*// kha bshad lo mas dben yang*/ gzhan don 'bras 253)bu ldan pas// mi tshe stong zad ma byas// cis kyang blo gros legs 'dug /bla ma sangs rgyas drin gyis// mun sgom 'thom por ma lus// rang rig chos skur mjal bas// byang chub lam sna zin 'dug /zhen 'dzin 'jur mdud dam pos// rang sems rang gi ma bcings// gang shar rang grol gnad shes// bsam bzhin snang ba bde 'dug /mi tshe'i lhag ma gang byung*// dam pa'i chos las gzhan min// 'jig rten bya ba spong zhing*// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam shog /gros legs 'dun ma shes pa'i// nyams dbyangs chos kyi bro brdung*// mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i rol mor/ 'bul gyi bkra shis stsol cig

/ 'di yan chad nyams gnas chen chu bo g.yas 'khyil gyi bla brang nor bu brtsegs pa'i yang dben gyi mtshams du smras pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ru/ rang sems rang ngo shes pa bla ma yi rnal 'byor// yengs med dran pas skyong ba gsol 'debs kyi dam pa/ 254)/bla ma phyi na mi bzhugs rang rig dang dbyer med// bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom na de ltar du mdzod cig /gsal stong zung 'jug rtogs pa yi dam gyi snyen sgrub// bskyed rdzogs gnyis med shes pa sgom sgrub kyi mchog gyur// yi dam phyi na mi bzhugs rang rig dang dbyer med// mchog mthun dngos grub bsgrub na de ltar du mdzod cig /rig rtsal 'gag med 'char ba mkha' 'gro yi rang bzhin// dgag sgrub re dogs bral ba phrin las kyi snying po// mkha' 'gro phyi na mi bzhugs rang rig dang dbyer med// las bzhi thogs med bsgrub na de ltar du mdzod cig /gnas chen dpal ri'i gangs 'dabs rgod tshang gi yang dben// dpa' bo ḍākki 'du ba'i tshogs khang du blangs pa'i// nyams myong gdams pa'i glu 'di rang sems kyi dga' ston// byin rlabs bka' drin char chen dga' ston du phob cig/ ༈ e ma/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i rten 255)mtshan ldan gyi bla ma ni thar pa'i lam mkhan gyi rab// gdams ngag gi bdud rtsi 'di yid bzhin nor bu bas lhag /phun sum tshogs dus 'dir gtan 'dun 'grub pa cig mdzad par zhu// 'chi bdag gi bdud po 'di dog kha'i grib so ltar 'ong*// bar do'i 'phrang ring der 'gyod kyang 'chi ba la thug /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsam na chos min phan pa med// rang dbang yod dus 'dir mi 'gyod grab chud cig mdzad par zhu// bslab shes kyi yon tan la mtha' rgya chod pa ni dka'// shes kyang rang rgyud kyi thog tu khel ba ni dkon// gnyid dang rnam g.yeng gis mi tshe zad lugs la bsam nas// dben gnas ri khrod du tshe mjug dril ba gcig mdzad par zhu// las sgrib bag chags 'di thog med nas ngan goms che// rnam rtog 'khrul 'khor 'di shugs drag gi 'gyur ldog mang*// yengs med dran rig gi bya ra

256)dang ma bral ba'i ngang*// mnyam rjes dbyer med kyi klong du gyur pa gcig mdzad par zhu// bla ma mched grogs la mos gus dag snang gis bsten// pha ma sems can la snying rje byang sems kyis skyongs/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi nyams len yengs med du 'bod// snying gtam gdams ngag 'di thugs la gzhag pa zhig mdzad par zhu// ༈ na maḥshrī gu ra we/ bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas// gang gi thugs rje yi drin las rang sems kyi gnas lugs// mi rtog rang rig gi ye shes don dam gyi mchod pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs la brtan bzhugs su gsol lo// 'gag med rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal snang stong du 'char ba'i// zhal phyag mtshan ma las 'das pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi lha sku// yang dag don mchog gi skyed rim spro bsdu dang bral 'di// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung la brtan bzhugs su 'bul lo// sna tshogs snang yul du gyur 257)pa'i tshogs drug gi longs spyod// gang shar zhen 'dzin gyis bslad min rig rtsal gyi rnam rol// dgag sgrub spong len dang bral ba'i rang grol gyi maṇḍal// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la brtan bzhugs su 'bul lo// 'jig rten sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor rmi lam gyi rgyal srid// bden 'dzin a 'thas kyi bag chags gzhi med du grol nas// dben gnas ri khrod kyi phyogs su bya btang gi brtul zhugs// gtan 'dun byang chub kyi go 'phang dngos grub tu stsol dang*// sku drin 'khor med kyi rje btsun sangs rgyas kyi spyi gzugs// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam gyi gdul byar brtse chen gyis gzigs pas// bskal brgyar zhabs pad kyi nor bu g.yo med du brtan zhing*// dam chos dge legs kyi char chen rgyun ldan du phobs shig ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje 'gro ba 'dren pa'i thugs rje can// skyabs sangs rgyas kun dngos lha yi lha// pha dran 258)chog rgyal po bla ma yi// zhabs rtsibs stong 'bar ba spyi bor bkod// lus longs spyod snang srid snod bcud dang*// nyams rtogs pa'i maṇḍal 'bul lags na// pha mkhyen brtse'i gter mdzod sgo phyes la// bu snying rje'i yul gyur bskyab tu gsol// rje bla ma'i rnam 'phrul gar gyi rol// lha yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tshogs// rtsal mthu stobs mnga' bdag dam can rnams// deng rnal 'byor byang chub gdong grogs zhu// khyed 'dir tshogs dad ldan lha mi kun// yid rnam shes dbang po bag phab nas// snyan ma yengs ngo mtshar glu la gson// don ma nor dgongs pa'i rgya mtshor bstim// de yan chad rten 'brel byin rlabs glu// da skabs don glu yi snying po ni// yongs gling bzhi'i mchog gyur 'dzam bu'i gling*// chos sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba'i sa// dgos rgyal bas lung bstan sngags kyi zhing*// ljongs byang phyogs kha ba can gyi shar// gong

259)tshang tshing nags khrod lho mon mtshams// chu rab 'jigs rba klong 'khrug pa'i ngogs// yul kun las mthar thug sbas pa'i zhing*// rje rgyal mchog padmas byin rlabs pas// mchog tshe 'dir thob pa'i gnas mchog na// gangs zur gsum dgung la mngon 'phags shing*// ri kun las mtho lhun brjid chags par// lha rang byung gzigs snang mtha' yas shing*// ma mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'thib pa der// gnas rgyal la dpal ri mi zer ro// gnam bai ḍūr 'khor lo 'bar ba las// char mu tig 'phreng ba chal ma chil// bar 'ja' 'od gur khyim rtags brgyad ris// dus rgyun ldan mchod sprin thibs se thibs// gangs rab dkar shel gyi mchod rten che// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku ru bzhugs// chu gser ldan g.yas nas 'khyil ba yis// mchog thun mong dngos grub rgyun mi chad// shin ljon pa mya 260)ngan med pa'i tshogs// lha lha mo'i gar stabs phyag rgya bsgyur// rtsi me tog sna tshogs rab bkra bas// yid 'phrog pa'i mchod rdzas thang mar brdal// bya ri dwags snyan pa'i glu gar gyis// sgra rol mo'i bye brag rmad du byung*// ri thabs shes phyag rgya bsnol ba'i dbus// yul grong brdal skyid pa'i mtsho mo brdol// 'bras 'bru drug dus su smin pa'i bcud// gser gzhong mar khus bkang ba bzhin// phyugs 'bri g.yag dga' ba'i rol rtsed 'phyo// nor 'dod dgu'i gter kha ngang gis phyes// sa de las snying por gyur pa yi// zhing ngo mtshar padmo bkod pa'i 'khyams// rje rgyal ba rig 'dzin mtshar dngar bas// lam bla med byang chub brnyes pa'i sa// gnas yang dben dpal gyi rgod tshang phug /nyams mi rtog rang shugs 'khrungs pa'i sa// brag rin chen ba gam brtsegs pa'i spor// blo bde ba'i rnal 'byor nyams dbyangs tsher// lha ma srin 261)mngon sum 'du ba yis// sgom yengs med dran rig skul ma byed// ma ḍākki'i tshogs 'khor dga' ston gyi// chos rtse gcig bsgrub la dngos sgrub ster/

mi'i rgyu 'grul ngang gis dben pa yis// tshe 'di snang g.yeng ba'i dgra dang bral/ don snying po dam chos lhur len na// gegs bar chad gtan bral dgos 'dod 'byung*// gnas gzhan las rmad byung khyad par can// 'dir slob rnams sngon bsags las 'phro bzang*// blo chos la gtod pa'i skal ldan kun// yid bsam don 'grub po a la la// de yan chad gnas chen ngo mtshar glu// dus gnyan po tshes bcu'i dga' ston lags// da snying gtam don gyi gdams ngag bshad// sngon 'khor ba thog med da lta'i bar// las nyon mongs 'khrul 'byams 'khor bar 'khyams// da gtan don gcig bsgrub la shin tu ran// de ran par ma zad phyis pa tsam// tshe sprin bar gyi nyi shur yud 262)tsam 'dir// gnyid rnam g.yeng lto gos kyi rtsol sgrub dang*// las don med la mi tshe 'das pa 'di// sngar phan chad song ba chud zos yin// da rang don yang dag bsgrub par 'tshal// tshe nges med nam mkha'i na bun yal// lus mi rtag 'byung 'dus khang rul 'gyel// sems bar do'i 'phrang la 'grim dus su// gdeng blo gtad ci zhig gang la byed// dus da lta rang dbang yod dus 'dir// lam yar mar so mtshams mi byed na// sems rnam rig bkra yang dbang po tshang*// gos ngur smrig gyon pa'i dgos ched ci// chos snying po'i bstan dang mjal dus su// zhag lo zla g.yeng ba'i dbang du btang*// nam shi dus kha chems 'jog pa kun// don 'grub par gda' 'am shes ldan rnams// phyi ltar snang mdzes mdzes 'dra ba'i chos// de shes shes mang yang dgos dus bslu// gnad zab mo tshe gcig byang chub lam// thabs bla ma'i gdams ngag bsgom par 'tshal/ 263)/sems ma bcos rang byung ye shes don// gnad sgom yengs las 'das gsal stong zung*// gshis dbyer med rtsal mdangs gang shar kun/ don chos skur lam khyer gnad du che// tshig brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo// 'gag bla ma'i gdams ngag tshig gsum 'dus// thabs stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi

/'bras rang gzhan don mchog 'grub par mdzod// de yan chad gdams ngag zab mo'i glu// gnas 'dir tshogs mi dang mi ma yin/ lha ga gnas bdag zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// chos glu ru blangs 'dis grol bar smon// slar 'dir bzhugs chos mdzad skyes bu sogs// yongs rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin kun// mchog mthun mong don gnyis mthar phyin zhing*// yul skye 'gro bed legs kun 'byung shog /glu ngo mtshar tshig don zab mo'i 'phreng*// ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rol mo dang*// khyed 'dir 264)bzhugs skal ldan mnyes phyir blangs// dus rtag tu bkra shis chos 'phel shog/ ces pa 'di dang le tshan gong 'og rnams ni/ gnas chen dpal ri gangs kyi 'dabs zhol rgod tshang dpal gyi yang dben du phyi nang gi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i 'du ba cher spyod pa'i dus su blangs pa'i skor ro// ༈ e ma/ gzhi khyab gdal stong nyid phyogs ris bral// chos 'dus ma byas pa rang gi klong*// gshis ye grol chen po'i gnas lugs las// blo bzo bcos med par phyam me 'di// rje chos kyi sku la mchod par 'bul// gdangs 'gags med rang gsal rig pa'i sgo// lam skyed rdzogs dbyer med ye shes sku// dbyibs kha dog mtshan ma'i spros dang bral// don rang rig rang gsal hrig ge 'di// rje longs spyod rdzogs skur mchod pa 'bul// rtsal ma 'gags rol mo'i cho 'phrul du// yul snang ba sna tshogs cir shar ba// kun rig rtsal chos nyid klong grol bas// yid zhen 'dzin med par khrol le 'di// rje sprul pa'i sku la 265)mchod par 'bul// chos lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi tha snyad kun// sems rang babs gnas lugs su ro gcig thim// nyams bde gsal mi rtog gi dkyil 'khor du// rje don dam bla ma dang 'du 'bral med// mchog srid zhi gtan sgrol gyi dngos grub zhu'o// ༈ e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar 'dod 'byung gi dbang rgyal// srid zhi'i gdung sel gyi nor bu// skyabs gnas bla med kyi zhabs pad/

'bral med gtsug rgyan du mchod nas// dus bzang dge legs kyi khri gdugs// dngos grub tshogs 'khor gyi mchod gral// rten 'brel smon lam gyis 'dzom dus// dga' ston chos dbyangs 'di blangs so/ ya gi gung sngon gyi dbyings nas// lha dbang klu rgyal gyi mthu stobs// sbrang char zim bu'i rgyun babs tshe// 'bru drug 'phel ba 'di ya mtshan// rnga yab dpal ri yi zhing khams// pad 'byung byin rlabs kyi phrin las// skal ldan gdul bya rnams smin mdzad/ 266)/rang cag rjes 'jug gi dpal lags// ma gi zab yangs kyi rgya mtshor// dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nor bu// ded dpon brtson ldan gyis blangs nas// skye 'gro'i dbul sel 'di ngo mtshar// gsung rab zab mdzod kyi snying khu// mtshan ldan bla ma yi drin las// 'chugs med lam bzang la tshud 'di// bsam na bka' drin du che 'dug /'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'dam las// rgyang bros bya btang gi brtul shugs// dben gnas ri khrod phyogs bsnyegs pas// gtan gyi mdun gros legs byung*// nam yang don med kyi las la// ma zhen grub thob kyi rjes zin// don gnyis 'bad med du 'grub pa'i// bkra shis gong 'phel du stsol zhig/ ༈ rje bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal// skyabs re sa ma nor blo re bde// gnas gar 'dug rgyal ba'i zhing khams nyid// yul bdag bzung ma dgos blo re bde// las ci byed bla ma'i zhabs tog bsgrub// tshe stong zad ma gyur blo re bde/ 267)/lam zab mo theg pa'i yang rtser zhugs// chos gzhan la mi smon blo re bde// gtan 'dun ma dam pa'i chos la dril// yid 'gyod med khong chud blo re bde// blo bde ba lnga yi gre chung gi /dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo dngos grub stsol// ༈ gzhi gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes la// 'phral 'khrul rtog gi dri mas ma bslad par// lta ba ming du btags mod rig pa'i gshis// chos sku'i ngo bo nyid du bla mas gsungs// lam zab rgu'i gnad kun gcig pa'i don// sems gang shar bzo med skyong ba la// sgom pa'i ming du btags kyang dmigs gtad bral// bcos ma'i 'jur mdud 'khrol na de nyid rang*// las 'du byed spyod lam kun tu yang*// blo a 'thas kyi zhen 'dzin ma zhugs na// spyod pa'i ming du btags na'ang sgyu ma'i 'phrul// bya byed las gsum rig pa'i rol pa nyid// chos lta sgom spyod gsum ro gcig pa'i/

268)/don mngon gyur 'bras bu brjod pa gang*// thob shor re dogs mtshan mas bcings min pa'i// yang dag don gyi sangs rgyas 'grub byin rlobs/ ces rang gi gcung po su dharma ti'i ngor blangs pa dge'o// na mo gu ru/ mtha' bral ka dag gi nam mkha' la// 'gags med gsal rig sprin chen 'khrigs// smon lam thugs rje'i glog stong 'khyug /bden tshig gi 'brug sgra ldir ba las// phan bde'i char chen dbab tu gsol// phyogs bral lta ba'i nam mkha' la/ yengs med sgom pa'i sprin chen 'khrigs// 'dzin med spyod pa'i glog stong 'khyugs// rang grol gyi 'brug sgra ldir ba las// nyams rtogs kyi char chen dbab tu gsol// skye 'gro bsod nams kyi zhing sa ru// skyabs gnas byin rlabs char chen phab// dngos grub dge legs kyi myu gu 'khrungs// smin grol byang chub kyi 'bras bu smin// sku gsum lhun grub tu 'byung bar shog/ ces byin 269) rlabs char 'bebs kyi glu 'di nyid/ yul khams rnams su than pa chen po byung ba'i tshe char dbab pa'i slad du blangs pas dngos grub ya mtshan gyi rtags mngon par gsal bar gyur pa'o// ༈ rje khams gsum yongs na zla bral ba// ngo mtshar padma'i lhums nyid las// rang byung sprul pas 'gro ba 'dul// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs pad la// bu mos gus gdung bas rab btud cing*// lan brgyar phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs kyis// dmigs med brtse chen thugs rje yis// rtag par gzigs shing byin gyis rlobs// khyed skal ldan skyes mchog rnal 'byor pa// chos snying po'i don la brtson mdzad pa'i// shākya'i mtshan can rigs kyi bu// snyan legs par gson dang e ma ho// spyir 'dus byas sgyu ma'i rang mtshang dang*// dgos bskal pa snyigs ma'i rnam 'gyur sogs// tshul ci la bsam zhing bltas na yang*// yid skyo nas snying rlung khong nas ldang*// chos 'dul

270)'dzin dge sbyong la phar bltas tshe// 'phral tshul 'chos ngos lkog gi na bun thibs// nang gsang sngags pa la phar bltas na// lta spyod ya bral gyi rba klong 'khrug /sgom rnal 'byor spyod la bltas na yang*// chos dang gang zag so sor 'thor// gzhan 'dren byed kyi bla gzugs la bltas pa'i tshe// rang las nyon 'khrul pa'i brtson rar chud// lar rang gzhan su la dpyad gyur kyang*// tshig kha bshad lo ma rgya che zhing*// thos bsam dang sgom sgrub gzhan don sogs// byas byas dang yong yong gi mig 'phrul gyis// dgos nges kyi mdo don rlung la bskur// mi tshe rmi lam gyi yun srid 'di// lto gos rnam g.yeng la zad byas nas// dkor sdig nyes ltung gi 'khur chen gyis// bar do'i 'phrang ring la 'o brgyal mchis// 'jig rten chags sdang gi grong khyer dbus// 'di snang chos brgyad kyi 'khrul chen la// bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don 271)yin lo// rang phung gzhan phung gi 'dun gros mkhan// zang zing brnyed 'tshol gyi zog po la// bla ma'am btsun par btags pa 'di// skyug log zhig snying gi dkyil nas skyes// ༈ kye ma'o/ blo chos la gtod nges kyi skal ldan rnams// dus ding sang gi gnas tshul 'di som la// phral 'dir snang gi 'dun mas ma g.yengs par// snying thag par lha chos zhig mdzod dang bu// chos zab zab dang yin yin gyi grangs mang zhing*// spros bcas kyi rnam dpyod gzhigs che yang*// rang sems kyi gnad don mi shes na// mtsho 'gram du skom grir shi dang mtshungs// chos phyag rdzogs sogs sgom rim rgya che zhing*// sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi sna tshogs kyang*// dgos don du rang rig gnyug ma'i don// rjen pa ru mthong ba kho na lags// chos lta ba zer ba'i sgra bo che// mtha' 272)dang bral sogs lung rigs kyis// gzhigs rtsod sna tshogs mang byed kyang*// rang sems gtan la phebs pa dkon// mtha' yod na yod chug med na med// tshig skam po'i lta bas dgos rgyu chung*// rang rig rang ngo shes pa la// lta ba mtho dman gyi gnyer khar zad// chos sgom pa zer ba'i sgra bo che// sgom la sgom brtan dang mi brtan sogs// zhen 'dzin gyi brgya mdud dam po yis// rnal 'byor pa rang nyid rang gis bcings// blos bsgom rgyu cig yod na 'dzin pa yod// 'dzin pas 'khrul pa lug rgyud spel// sgom med do snyam yang mi dgos kyi// rnam rtog kho sgom du ye nas med// 'gyu ba bkag na ye shes 'gags// gnas pa bsgrub na bcos ma nyid// gdod nas dag pa'i sems nyid la// gnas 'gyu la 'dam kha ci'i phyir byed// ma bcos par brlom yang bcos ma'i sgom// sdug tsir du skyong

273)ba'i sgom chen la// srog rlung rin gyi nyo ba las// nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i re thag chod// sems rang babs su gnas kyang sgom gyi ngang*// sna tshogs su 'gyur yang rig rtsal rol// ci ltar shar yang gnas lugs kyi ngang*// dgag sgrub kyi lhan pa 'debs don med// gang snang cir shar rang rig gis// ngo shes tsam du byed pa la// dran pa zhes ming du btags pa tsam// a 'thas kyi 'jur dran 'dir mi dgos// zhi lhag dang mnyam bzhag rjes thob dang*// bskyed rdzogs dang mtshan bcas mtshan med sogs// tha snyad kyi ming tshogs mtha' yas kyang*// rig thog tu 'dus pa shes par gces// chos spyod pa zer ba'i sgra bo che/ spyad rgyu dang spyod mkhan gyi mtshan mas dben// rang rig yengs 'khrul med pa'i ngang*// ci byed chos nyid spyod pa lags// tha mal du yengs dang a 'thas 'khrul/ 274)/'di kho nas phral yun gyi 'dun ma 'chugs// yengs 'khrul med na sdig sgrib dang*// nyes ltung gang la brten nas 'byung*// gang shar chos nyid rnam rol dang*// dgag sgrub mtshan mas spyod don med// ma bcos lhug pa'i spyod pa las// brtul zhugs smyon spyod kyang ci'i phyir byed// chos 'bras bu zer ba'i sgra bo che// thob ma thob re dogs byas byas pas// sgyu ma'i 'khrul gyis sgom chen bslus// thob shor gyi re dogs dgos pa med// gdod ma'i mgon po man chad nas// 'jag mig srin bu yan chad la// chos sku la che chung ma mchis tshe// 'khor 'das kun sems nyid gcig pu'i 'phrul// ma gi mnar med dmyal khams nas// ya gi sangs rgyas zhing khams man// thun mong gdul bya'i snang tshul tsam// mdang rmi lam bzang ngan dang khyad par ci// rmi lam kyang rang snang 'khrul sgo las// bden pa'i don du su zhig 275)mthong*// thams cad rang rig 'gags med kyi// rol rtsal du thag chod gcig pus chog/ e ma/

mang du brjod pas ci zhig bya// rang rig bla ma chos sku dang*// 'bral med nges shes ma rnyed na// mtshon byed bla ma 'dus byas nyid// 'dus byas chos la blo gtad bral// 'di dang phyi ma bar do zhes// tha dad bde sdug 'dzin pa sems// sems la skye 'chi bde sdug med// skye med klong nas 'gag med 'phyo/ nga dang khyod dang gdams ngag gsum// rang rig ye shes dbyings su gcig /gcig dang du ma'i tha snyad kyang*// ming tshig tsam du btags par zad// skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs mtha' dag tu// 'bral med rang sems bla mar shes pa'i bu// 'pho 'gyur gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang*// bdag dang 'gro kun ro gcig e ma ho//

zhes lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi glu ring 'di nyid/ dad ldan gyi rnal 'byor shākya bstan 'dzin pas ring mo'i sa nas bskul 276) ba'i ngor/ rgod phug mya ngan med pa'i nags khrod nas yi ger bris nas basprings pa maṅga lam// ༈ stong gsum zhing khams 'dod yon gyi rgya mtshor/ snod bcud bkod mdzes 'dab rgyas kyi padmo// dngos 'byor mchod sprin maṇḍal du 'bul gyi// dag snang rab 'byams dngos grub 'dra stsol dang*// dal 'byor rin chen dpag bsam gyi sdong po// phung khams skye mched lo 'bras kyi phyug 'di// rang snang rnam dag maṇḍal du 'bul gyi// yid bzhin 'dod 'byung dngos grub 'dra stsol dang*// mtha' bral rang sems blo 'das kyi nam mkhar// gang shar 'dzin med gza' skar du bkra ba// nyams rtogs mthun rkyen maṇḍal du 'bul gyi/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas dngos grub 'dra stsol cig/ ces pa 'di/ bde gshegs tshe'i phug tu blangs so// ༈ mun sel nyi ma dgung sngon la shar bas// ge sar bzhad pa'i pad tshal rnams rgyas shing*// rkang drug bung ba'i bsam don du 'grub byung*// 'grib med gsal mdzod khri gdugs kyi nyi ma/ 277)/lho sprin klong nas sbrang char de babs pas// rtsi shing lo 'dab 'bru drug rnams 'khrungs shing*// rma bya gzhon nu'i dga' ston du 'phel byung*// char rgyun phobs dang chu 'dzin gyi sngon mo// mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku drin gyis skyangs pas// bstan 'gro'i don bzang rlabs chen rnams 'grub cing*// dad ldan bu la bka' drin du che byung*// thugs rjes gzigs shig rje btsun gyi bla ma// byin gyis rlobs dang thar lam la 'god mdzod/ /ces pa yang rgod phug bya skyibs kyi yang dben du'o// ༈ rje bla ma'i thugs rje zhwa la zhugs// zhwa byin rlabs can dgongs 'dus gtsug zhwa 'di// pha sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung*// bod gangs can du byon pa'i dbu zhwa yin// zhwa bzo tshul gyi lo rgyus brjod pa na// rang sems rnam dag gi 'jam phrug dang*// dad pa 'gyur med kyi phying dkar gnyis/

bla ma mtshan ldan 278)gyi bzo bo yis// dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi tshos kha bsgyur// gdams ngag zab gnad kyi bzo dras byas// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi phyi nang sbyar// lta ba yas phub kyi zhwa thod dang*// spyod pa mas 'dzegs kyis 'dab zhol sbrel// rang rig gcer mthong gi mdun sgo gtod// sdom pa dam tshig gi mu 'dril btang*// sku gsum mngon gyur gyi zhwa mo bzos// 'di gon pas gtan gyi 'dun ma 'grub// zhwa rtse mo mtho zhing rno ba 'di// gzhi lta ba'i yang rtse rtogs pa'i brda// zhwa sked pa zlum la lhun chags pas// lam sgom pa'i ri rgyal brtan pa'i brda// zhwa rgyab zhol 'khor mar 'dug pa ni// tshul spyod pa blang dor bral ba'i brda// zhwa mdun sgo gsal bar byed pa ni// chos 'bras bu'i rang zhal mthong ba'i brda// zhwa gyon pas dang ba 'dren pa ni// gzhan don rtsol 279)med 'byung ba'i brda// rje bla mas byin gyis rlob pa'i zhwa// ma mkha' 'gros dngos grub stsol ba'i zhwa// lha chos skyong bran du 'khol ba'i zhwa// zhwa yid bzhin nor bu 'dod dgu 'byung*// zhwa che ba'i yon tan ngo mtshar glu// khyed 'dir bzhugs snyan du phul ba lags/ bkra shis bde legs kyi rten 'brel zhu// byin rlabs zhwa'i glu 'di yang rang gi gcung po'i ngor blangs pa // ༈ dgung khri gdugs 'char ba shar gyi phyogs/ yul ma ki kong rong zad pa'i mtha'// 'ja' na bun 'khrigs pa'i go mtshams nas// gangs mtho la brjid chags lhun sdug pa// gnas dpal ri'i gangs chen mthong ba'i mthus// pha bla ma sangs rgyas snying nas dran// de dran pas gdung ba'i glu dbyangs 'di// rje bla ma'i snyan la gsan lags bsam// bdag snyom las can gyi sprang po la// thugs snying rje'i gzigs pa ma 280)g.yel bar// gnas ngan song 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// dus gtan du skyobs shig bla ma mkhyen// ༈ 'dab stong rgyas pa padma'i tshal du// rkang drug ldan pa'i bung bas slebs tshe// bcud ldan snying po gangs ri'i zil mngar// rgyun ldan 'thungs ba'i rten 'brel lags so// gting zab yangs pa'i rgya mtsho'i klong na// lha bya ngang pa gzhon nu sleb tshe// dga' bde'i rol rtsed rnam 'gyur mang pos// nyams dga' skyong ba'i rten 'brel lags so// bkra shis byin chags phun tshogs gnas 'dir// las 'phro 'dzom pa'i 'dir tshogs skal ldan// tshe ring nad med dam chos 'phel bas// yang yang 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel lags so//

༈ gnam g.yu yi 'khor lo 'bar ba dang*// rgyan rin chen nyi zla'i phra tshom gnyis// bkod mdzes pas gling bzhi'i mun pa sel// de 'gro ba'i bsod nams rten 'brel yin// 'khor lo la sprin 281)gyis ma g.yogs shing*// nyi zla gnyis gza' dang bral ba yis// gling bzhi'i mun sel rten 'brel de// yang yang du 'dzom pa'i smon lam zhu// ༈ sa 'dab brgyad padmo'i ge sar la// yul gling bzhi ri rab ze'u 'bru bkra// ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs// de 'jig rten spyi mthun rten 'brel yin// sa padma mi shigs brtan pa dang*// yul skye 'gro 'pho 'chugs med pa ru// dus rtag tu bde skyid rten 'brel du// yang yang 'dzom pa'i smon lam zhu// ༈ khyed 'dir bzhugs dad ldan pho mo dang*// bdag rgyal khams sprang po bya btang gnyis// 'dir 'dzom pas dga' bde'i longs spyod 'phel// 'di sngon nas smon lam 'brel pa yin// 'dir bzhugs rnams sku khams bzang ba dang*// rnal 'byor pa nyams rtogs gong 'phel zhing*// ci bsam pa'i don kun myur 'grub nas// yang yang du 'dzom pa'i smon lam zhu// zhes pa rnams kyang gzhan 282) bskul gyi ngor smras pa dge'o// ༈ rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i zla zhal de 'bar bas// dad brgya'i ku mud ge sar du rgyas shing*/ lag sor padmo 'dzum pa dang bsdongs nas// bla ma'i sku la brtan bzhugs su 'bul lo// dam chos 'brug sgra ldir dbyangs su thos pas// gus ldan rma bya gzhon nu nga tshims shing*// nyams myong gar bsgyur rnam rol dang bsdongs nas// bla ma'i gsung la brtan bzhugs su 'bul lo// dgongs klong rnam dag mkha' dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor// thugs rje'i nyi 'od khyab gdal du shar zhing*// rang rig ye shes rang gsal du bsdongs nas// bla ma'i thugs la brtan bzhugs su 'bul lo// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la brtan bzhugs su 'bul lo//

༈ sems nyid 'dus ma byas dang po'i sangs rgyas dang*// rje bka' drin can mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs// bdag mos gus can gdung bas gsol 'debs na// khyed thugs rje can brtse bas gzigs su gsol/ 283)/gnas ngo mtshar can phyogs med kyi rgyal khams na// blo gu yangs can gtad med kyi sprang po 'phyo// las rnam g.yeng can 'jig rten gyi bya ba la// yid skyo shas can zhen log gi blo rgod langs// rje byin rlabs can sgrub rgyud kyi rnam thar de// tshe nges med can bya btang gis 'grub par smon// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub na dga' ba la// mkha' mnyam kyi 'gro ba sgrol na skyid pa la// bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i mos gus dang gcig /'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i byams sems dang gnyis// mched lcam lha ru shar ba'i dag snang dang gsum// de gsum sems la 'char ram 'dir bzhugs kyi skal ldan rnams// 'khor ba sgyu mar shes pa'i nges 'byung dang gcig /cis kyang dgos med mthong ba'i zhen log dang gnyis// nam 'chi cha med dran pa'i skyo shas dang gsum/ de gsum snying la skyes sam 'dir 284)bzhugs kyi skal ldan rnams// rgyu 'bras bslu med shes pa'i nges shes dang gcig /mi tshe chos la dril ba'i 'dun gros dang gnyis// shi dus 'gyod med byed pa'i rtog gtad dang gsum// de gsum grabs su tshud dam 'dir bzhugs kyi skal ldan rnams// chos kun sems su shes pa'i thag chod dang gcig /sems nyid chos skur rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad dang gnyis// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug nyams len dang gsum// de gsum rgyud la khel lam 'di bzhugs kyi skal ldan rnams/ /dri ba glu ru blangs 'di nyams len gyi gsal 'debs lags so// ༈ skyabs gnas kyi snying po bla mar shes// de shes pas gang byung thugs rjer go /da skyid sdug gi snang ba ci byung yang*// skyabs re ltos gzhan du nga mi 'tshol// srid gsum gyi 'byor pa sgyu mar shes// de shes pa ci kyang dgos med go

/da lto gos kyi dbul phongs ci byung kyang*// nor zang zing 285)gi rjes phyir nga mi 'breng*// 'dre gdon kun rang snang 'khrul par shes// de shes pas 'khrul snang stog par go/ da 'jigs skrag cho 'phrul ci byung yang*// thabs 'dre brdung bsrung 'khor nga mi bsgom// gang shar kun sems kyi rol par shes// de shes pas bcos min nyams len go /da 'gyu gnas 'phro 'du ci byung yang*// sgom bzang 'dod dgag sgrub nga mi byed// gang byung gis chog pa'i nyams len gnad// gnad zab mo bla ma'i drin las brnyed// drin lan du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// dngos grub tu sku gsum mngon gyur zhu'o// dpal de ring bkra shis dus bzang 'dir// gnas longs spyod 'dzom pas skyid pa la// pha bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin ltar bstibs// nyams rtogs pa gong 'phel skyid pa la// lha yi dam dngos grub char ltar 'bebs// yid ci bsam 'grub pas skyid pa la/ 286)/ma mkha' 'gro'i phrin las glog ltar 'khyug /rkyen bar chad med pas skyid pa la// las smon lam 'brel pas 'dir tshogs rnams// thugs chos su mthun pas skyid pa la// dbyangs skyid pa rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'di// zhal 'dir bzhugs rnams kyi dga' ston mdzod/ 'di rnams kyang gcung pos bskul ba'i ngor blangs pa'o/ na mo mahā gu ru padma ka rā ye/ dpal dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas ma lus kun// gzhi mnyam nyid kyi chos dbyings thig le cher// don ro gcig tu 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs la// rje pad 'byung zhes snyan par grags pa'i mtshan// zhing 'jig rten gyi khams kun yongs khyab pa// nged snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rmu rgod la// gzugs tha mal gyi mi yi gsob zhugs kyang*// thugs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phrin las ni// rje rgyal ba kun dang rnam dbyer med// pha drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// gnas bde chen gyi 'khor

287)lo'i yang thog tu// sku 'ja' 'od kyi mdangs ldan mtshan dpe bkra// gsung dam chos kyi sgo brgya theg chen bcud// thugs zab gsal gyi ye shes mkha' ltar khyab// rje byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod dam pa de// bdag blo dman gyi skyabs mgon dpung gnyen mchog /yid dad gus kyi gdung shugs mtsho nang du// sku mtshan dpe'i zla snang sgyu 'phrul shar// blo log rtog gi rba rlabs mi 'khrug cing*// phral mnyam 'grogs kyi 'khregs dar ma chags par// yid rab dwangs mtsho chen rnyog bral na'ang*// rje drin can gyi rnam thar gsal lam lam// de dran pas dngos 'dzin gyi ri mo yal// sems bzo med kyi khong yus gting nas langs// lag sor bcu'i yal 'dabs snying khar zum// ngag gsol 'debs kyi nga ro 'brug ltar bsgrag /bu dad gus kyi nyams 'gyur ngang tshul ni// pha mkhyen ldan gyi 288)gzigs pas dgongs lags sam// khyed sgrib bral gyi ye shes spyan yangs pos// chos dngos kun gyi mtshan nyid gsal po ru// dus rgyun chad med par gzigs lags na// bdag nyams thag gi gdul bya cis mi gzigs// lus longs spyod dang gtan 'dun gyi dngos po kun// blo ltos med du mchod pa'i maṇḍal 'bul// dus 'di nyid nas mthar thug byang chub bar// pha rje btsun gyi gdul byar gyur nas kyang*// chos nges don la mnga' dbang 'byor ba dang*// lam myur zab kyi shing rta'i srol zhugs la// gegs chos min gyi bar chad gtan bral zhing*// chos snang bzhi yi sa lam mthar phyin te// dpal kun bzang gi rgyal sa zin nus pa'i// dbang dngos grub kyi chu bo dbab tu gsol// lus sgyu 'phrul gyi lha skur gdod nas dag /ngag shugs 'byung gi rang sgra rdo rje'i sngags// yid byung tshor gyi rtog pa chos nyid rtsal// ye gdod ma nas lhun grub yin mod kyang*// las bag chags 289)kyi rang sgrib rang la 'thum// sngon thog med nas da bar 'khrul yun ring*// 'di rang grol du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs//

༈ kye ma'o/ snang grags kun gzod nas dag pa yi// rang ngo la 'pho 'gyur ma mchis kyang*// ltar snang gi cho 'phrul rmi lam las// ches cher du zar zir rmi lam bzhin// 'pho 'chugs dang g.yo 'khrugs drag por 'tshubs// sa chu dang me rlung nam mkha' sogs// 'byung khams kyi chag 'jig go log mang*// skye 'gro rnams sdug bsngal 'tshub 'gyur gyis// spyod 'gros kun ngan dgu sdug bcu byed// chos pa ru rloms pa'i dred po yis// sa steng kun dog por khengs na yang*// rgyal gsung bzhin mthun pa'i chos pa ni// u dum gyi me tog las kyang dkon// bla gzugs rnams chos brgyad rta bang 'gran// mgyogs dar ni pho zo gang mthos thob// dkor nag gi rnyed 'tshol su rems la// 'gro 290)don dang phrin las ming du 'dogs// don 'bras ni rang gzhan gnyis phung bsgrub// dge sbyong rnams sha chang gi bcud len 'bad// dam sdom kun khyi la rdo 'phen ltar// yang yang du len zhing nan gyis 'phangs// bud med dang zas nor gyi rtsol sgrub 'di// lha chos zhig yin na ci ma rung*// gshin gson gyi skyabs yul byas byas kyang*// rang nyid kyi re gnas gang la byed// rgyal bstan la zhugs nas rgyal bstan nyid// bsnub thabs la nan ltar brtson lugs 'di// mi mngon gyi dbyings nas rgyal kun dang*// dkon mchog rnams thugs kyi bzod lags sam// rnam 'dren kun zol zog gis rnyed 'tshol 'bad// dge 'dun rnams sde 'khrug gi thal kha rgyag /sgom chen rnams grong chog bsnyen pa skyel// yon bdag rnams zog mkhan la dad gus che// dge rtsa ru srog gcod kyi mchod sbyin dar// chos 'jig rten tshul lugs 'di 'dra'i mthus/ 291)/grib lhongs de dkar phyogs lha la phog /nad yams dang sad ser mu ges mnar// 'thab 'khrug dang ngan spyod kyi rlung dmar 'tshubs// lo re dang zla zhag song bzhin du// ngan ltas kyi rba klong ches cher g.yo// 'di skya ser gyi spyod tshul rgyu 'bras nyid// bslu med du mngon sum smin lags pas// blo rnam rig bkra ldan gyi gang zag rnams// yid skyo shas kyi snang ba zhig mi 'khrungs sam//

༈ pha thugs rje'i gter chen gyi bla ma rnams// nged snyigs dus kyi sems can la gzigs re ran// yul snod bcud kyi 'gyur 'khrug zhi bar mdzod// ma 'gro kun gyi blo kha dge la bsgyur// chos grub mtha'i chags sdang dbyings su snyom// las chos min gyi ngan spyod rgyun thag chod// mgon thub bstan gyi sa gzhi snyoms par gdal// chos sgrub rgyud kyi lo 'bras smin par mdzod// rje pad 'byung gi 292)thugs rje stobs skyed nas// bdag sems can gyi las nyon rgyu 'bras kun// don dge legs kyi chos dbyings nam mkha' cher// ro mnyam pa nyid du grol bar mdzod// ༈ mtha' yas zhing gi rab 'byams rgyal ba'i tshogs// sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse'i stobs// gcig bsdus padma thod phreng thugs rje'i bdag /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bor blo thag chod// de nyid dran dang bsgom dang 'bod pa'i mthus// phral yun 'dod don kun 'grub bar chad zhi// tshe gcig thar lam byang chub snying po la// bdag gzhan 'gro ba mtha' dag reg gyur cig

ces bod kyi mthar thug bod chen po'i yul gyi nang tshan spu bo'i rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur ba/ mngon mtho nges legs kyi 'byor pa rgya mtshos yongs su gang ba'i sa skyong mi'i bdag po dbang drag srung zhes mtshan gyi sgra dbyangs grags pa khu dbon gnyis kyi bzhed pa skong ba'i slad kho nar/ yi ge'i lam du spel ba gaṅga laṃ bha wantu// ༈ ngo mtshar gnas kyi 293) bkod pa brjod pa skyo ba sangs byed rdo rje'i glu tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba/ drin can bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang bdag 'dra dus mtha'i ban chung sna tshogs rang grol 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i yo lang la zhen pa log ste/ dpal ri rgod tshang phug par mi lo bcu dgu dang zla ba bdun du dben pa bstan zhing dge sbyor la brtson pa'i skabs/ re zhig rang lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa'i dbyar zla gsum la babs pa'i tshe/ dpal ri gangs kyi mgul/ byang chub kyi snying po mngon par mtho ba'i rtse mor gsang spyod ro snyoms la phyin te/ zla ba gsum dang zhag nyer gcig gi bar du bsdad cing*/ gnas de'i sa dmigs shin tu mtho zhing gnyan pa zhig tu rin po che'i bum par dar zab sman 'bru rin chen sna tshogs dang*/ sa sna rdo sna byin rlabs dam rdzas khyad par can dang bcas pas bkang ba'i dkyil du/ spyir 'jig rten gyi khams/ dgos bod yul gangs can/ khyad par kong lung ral gsum gyi sems can la bde skyid 'byung zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i smon lam rgya cher bris pa'i shog dril bcug nas rab tu gnas te bum gter 294) du sbas/ ka shi ka'i ras la bcom ldan 'das kyis yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug mdor gsungs pa'i bde chig smon lam yongs rdzogs su bris pa la gos chen dar zab kha dog 'byung khams dang mthun pa'i dar lces brgyan pa btsugs/ tsandan dang a ka ru sogs shing sna'i bsangs bsur gyi khrod du yang byin rlabs dam rdzas btab pa'i du bas bar snang bkang zhing*/

phyogs thams cad du me tog 'thor nas shis brjod smon lam gyi rigs rgya chen por byas/ gzhan yang*/ dus bzang thams cad la tshogs gtor gyi mchod pa ci 'byor bshams te bstan pa dang sems can gyi don kho na'i gsol 'debs smon lam sogs la 'bad cing gnas pa'i bar skabs shig tu gnas de nyid kyi chags tshul zhing bkod kyi glu 'dir bzhin gyis shig ces/ rang gi gcung pos bskul ba'i ngor blangs pa ni/ ༈ na ma padma ka rā ya/ skyabs gsum gyi rgyal ba dkon mchog kun// rang byung gi padma'i rgyal po ru// gsang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs par// skyabs su mchi snying nas gsol ba 'debs// de nyid kyi gdul zhing kong 295)yul mthil// mthar thug tu zad pa'i sa mtshams su// gnas rgya la zer ba'i sgra bo che// rtse rdum gyi gangs chen ma lags sam// ri mtho mtho dang gnyan gnyan mang lags kyang*// phyogs gang nas bltas kyang sgrib med du// ri kun gyi yang rtser 'od lhag ge /gsal bar du mthong ba dpal ri'i gangs// lha bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du// rje padmas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad// gnas de mgul longs spyod 'khor lo ru// sa byang chub yang rtse'i sgrub gnas 'di// dbyibs padma kha bye'i ze'u 'bru'i tshul// yid rab dwangs spro ba 'phel ba'i gnas// shar khri gdugs 'char ba'i sgo mo ru// 'dzom gangs dkar mkha' 'gro'i ra ba yod// 'bras sā lu skye zhing ras 'thags gyon// mon 'jang yul zhes bya'i rgyab ri yin// lho ma la ya ri gnam lcags 'bar// lha dam can gnas 296)pa'i pho brang ste// skye bo rnams dri lha rtse rnon zer// gnas padma bkod pa'i phu ri yin// nub ma ma mthing gi mtsho mo ni// ma mtsho sman rgyal mo'i bsti gnas te// kong lung pa'i bde skyid longs spyod kyi/ sa gnad dang rten { gu ru rin po ches gter kha mang por lung bstan no/

mchan/ } 'brel 'di na yod// byang gangs ri'i gnas chen yongs grags dang*// yan lag brgyad ldan gyi bdud rtsi'i chu// ngo mtshar du ma'i gzigs snang tshogs// byin rlabs kyi dpal du 'bar ba yod// dbus byang chub kyi snying po'i yang rtse 'dir// 'dod yon gyi mchod pa phun sum tshogs// sngo sman sna tshogs kyi me tog gi /skyed tshal yid 'ong gi spang gshongs dang*// shug pa bal dkar gyi dri bzang gi /bdug spos bsung zhim gyi dwangs re spro// nam langs dang nyi shar dus mnyam pas// mun sel nang gsal du lhun gyi grub// bdud rtsi'i chu 297)mig gis dri chab kyis// nyon mongs tsha gdung gi gnod pa bral// rug pa chu rug rme mo sogs// rab byung zhal zas kyi 'tsho ba yod// bya tshe ring gdangs bya'i glu dbyangs kyi// sgra snyan pos yid snang 'gyur bar byed// lar mgo nag mi yi rgyu 'phrul med// 'jig rten rnam g.yeng gi dgra dang bral// sprin na bun gyi bla bres rtag tu phubs// sems g.yeng ba'i bar chad de yis sel// 'ja' lnga ldan gyi drwa ba ris su bris// gnas bzang ba'i nges shes de yis bskyed// char kha ba rgyun mi chad 'babs pas// sgom yengs med kyi sku mtshams ngang gis dam// gangs nyil ba'i 'ur sgra 'brug ltar sgrog /chos nyid kyi rang sgra ngo yang sprod// brag g.yang ri mtho gzar 'jigs tshul gyis// tshe mi rtag nges 'byung bskul mar byed// bya ri dwags bag yangs spyod tshul gyis// byams snying rje shugs 'byung 298)rgyun chad med// ma mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub tshogs 'khor gyis// rmi lam kun dga' bde'i rol par 'char// gnas 'di 'dra'i ya mtshan bkod pa rnams// tshe blos thong gi chos pa'i dpal du che// bdag mi rgan nam 'chi cha med la// rkang 'gro dad kha la min lags kyang*/ rje rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ri khrod 'dir// lam bgrod par dka' yang snying rus bskyed// gnas ya mtshan la bsam ste brtson pas bgrod// skyabs bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab// ma sems can bde ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs// chos snying po don gyi yang bcud blangs// sems rang rig gi rang 'gros dkyus thog bcad// rkyen gang byung la gtad med kyi 'bur 'joms byas// phyi lha 'dre yang rang sems kyi rgyan du 'khyer// blo skyid sdug kun chu yi ri mor bltas// lar thams cad chos nyid rol par bstim// bdag ro snyoms kyi don 'bras 'grub nas byung*/

299)/khyed phyi rabs rjes 'jug gi chos pa rnams// kha byi khung tsam 'di gso ba la// mi tshe grong 'khyams su ma byed par// gnas dben khrod sgrub rgyud kyi gdan sa mchog /'di lta bur kha lo yar bsgyur dang*// gtan 'dun gyi gros 'go legs nas 'ong*// don med kyi bya byed ma mang bar// rang sems kyi gnyer kha gyis shig dang*// byang chub kyi lam bzang bgrod par 'gyur// de skad du smra ba'i gnas mchog ni// shar phyogs kyi dpal ri gangs khrod 'dabs// byang chub kyi snying po'i yang dben du// gcung nor bzang chos kyi dbang po dang*// ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rol mor phul// mkha' khyab kyi 'gro la phan bde'i rgyur// 'di nyid kyis yongs su 'grub par shog/ sgrub gnas zhing bkod kyi glu // na mo padma ka rā ya/ dal 'byor mi lus phun tshogs thob dus 'dir// dpal mgon bla ma yid bzhin nor bu la/ 300)/ci mdzad legs mthong gang gsungs bka' bsgrub pas// mnyes pa mthar phyin byed pa byang chub lam/ 1 /nam 'chi cha med rmi lam snang ba tsam// mi tshe skad cig re la thung du 'gro// rgas kha'i rgyags grabs byas kyang sdod nges med// 'chi kha'i lam sna 'tshol ba byang chub lam/ 2 /'gro kun pha mar gyur la khyad par med// dgra gnyen chags sdang byed pa 'khrul pa'i las// de bas byams dang snying rje byang sems dang*// dag sna phyogs med sbyong ba byang chub lam/ 3 /rgyu 'bras bslu med dge sdig 'bras bu smin// 'khor ba'i khams su gar skyes bde ba med// spang blang tshul bzhin sgrub dus nga res tsam// sdig spong dge la 'bad pa byang chub lam/ 4 /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems 'di// rang rig dran pas rtag tu ma bskyangs na// a 'thas lug rgyud 'khrul pas gtan phung rgyu// ma yengs rang 'tsho bzung ba byang chub lam/ 301)5 /byang chub lam gyi rtsa ba'i nyams len gnad// zab mo sna lngar dril ba'i glu chung 'di// u dum wa ra lta bu rnyed dka'i chos// bla ma'i zhal gdams lags kyi thugs dgyes mdzod// glu 'di byang chub lam lnga'i glu// tshig 'di snying gtam zab mo'i tshig

/don 'di nyams len gnad kyi don// 'di yis gzhan la phan par shog ces pa 'di yang byang chub yang rtse'i dben gnas su/ rang gi gcung po na re/ sngon gyi dpal ldan mkha' spyod pa sogs kyi byang chub lam gyi glu che chung sna tshogs gda' bas/ 'o skol gyis kyang byang chub kyi gnas 'dir byang chub kyi glu zhig gyis dang zer ba'i ngor blangs pa dge'o// ༈ pha bla ma sangs rgyas kun dngos 'di// dpe yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel 'dra// ci bsam dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i mtshan la// snying thag pa'i mos gus bskyed re ran/ 1 /lus sgyu ma'i khang rul g.yar po 'di// dpe g.yang sa'i sdong gog rnying pa 'dra/ 302)/nam yang 'gyel bar 'gyur nges thag chod la// sems mi rtag rang rgyud bskul re ran/ 2 /stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mnga' thang yang*// dpe mig 'phrul mkhan gyi rtsed mo 'dra// snying po ci yang med pa'i nor rdzas 'dra// blo zhen 'dzin sred pa spang re ran/ 3 /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong mang po kun// dpe bcud ldan 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'dra// yang bcud nges don mar gyi snying po la// gnad nyams len rgyud la sbyor re ran/ 4 /dbyangs nges 'byung bskul ba'i glu chung 'di// dpe gcong nad sel ba'i sman mchog 'dra// snyoms las le lo'i nad kyi gnyen po yin// don legs par soms la nyams bzhes zhu'o// 5 ༈ a ho/ mtshan ldan bla ma dang gcig gdams ngag zab mo dang gnyis/ rang sems rjen pa dang gsum/ 'di gsum 'dzom dus nyams len mi byed na 'khrul tshabs che'o// 303) bsam blo legs par thong*/ dal 'byor mi lus dang gcig sangs rgyas bstan pa dang gnyis// rang dbang rang thob dang gsum/ 'di gsum 'dzom dus dam chos ma nus na phung tshabs che'o/ phral phugs legs par bsam mo// mi rtag 'chi ba dang gcig bar do'i 'jig skrag dang gnyis/ ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dang gsum/ 'di gsum byung dus grabs chud ma byas na 'gyod tshabs che'o//

rdog gtad legs par mdzod/ ces pa 'di yang*/ rang gi gcung po dang*/ smin grol snying po gnyis kyi bskul ngor smras pa'o// ༈ rgyal dbang padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs so// dal 'byor mi lus yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dug go /'jig rten g.yeng bas dal 'byor 'd-i stong zad du 'dug go /blo rgyud chos dang 'dres nges su byin gyis rang rlobs shig /mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// mi tshe 'di kun rmi lam gyi snang 304)ba tsam 'dug go /'chi ba nam mkha'i thog chen las myur ba ru 'ong ngo// sgo gsum chos kyis 'da' ba ru byin gyis rang rlobs shig /mchog sprul bzang po rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal gyi btson ra ru 'dug go /chos med ser gzugs rang gis rang bsrung mkhan du gda' 'o// rang rgyud gting nas 'thul ba ru byin gyis rang rlobs shig /rig 'dzin chos nyid klong grol la gsol ba 'debs so// sems can thams cad pha ma'i rang bzhin du 'dug go /dgra gnyen chags sdang 'khrul pa'i yo langs su 'dug go /'jig rten zhen pa gtan zad du phyin gyis rang rlobs shig /drin chan sna tshogs rang grol la gsol ba 'debs sogs// sangs rgyas thod bla ma'i rnam sprul du 'dug go /bla ma'i thugs dang rang rig 'di dbyer med du 'dug go /rang rig chos sku rang grol du byin gyis rang rlobs shig /rtse gcig dad pas gdung dbyangs kyis gsol 305)ba 'debs so// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can la thugs rje yis gzigs shig /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa yi dngos grub tu stsol zhig /srid gsum bde la 'god pa yi nus ldan du shog cig/ gcung po nor bzang pas/ sngon rgyal ba rgod tshang pa de nyid kyi snang ba bden med zang thal gyi grub rtags mdzad dus kyi gsung mgur dang 'dra ba zhig dgos zer ba'i ngor blangs pa dge'o//

༈ na mo gu ru/ don gnas lugs kyi cha nas spros pas dben// rtsal 'gag med kyi rol pa cir yang 'char// gnad yin lugs kyi 'gag don sems su gcig /sems rang ngo rang rig gi bla mar 'dud// khyed dad can gyi skal ldan bkra shis mtshan// sngon smon lam gyi 'brel pa bzang po'i mthus// bdag kun spangs kyi rjes 'gro rgan po la// chos rdo rje'i glu ru smros shig ces// gang bzhed pa'i don skong 'di ltar 'bul// lus 306)dal 'byor 'di dbul pos gter brnyed ltar// dus da res thob pa'i dga' tshor la// 'di stong zad don med du ma song bar// gtan 'dun ma zhig dge bas bsgrub par zhu// rgyu 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i gzugs phung 'di// rkyen 'chi bdag gi thog chen nam kyang phog /tshe nges med la blo na ma ring bar// lam 'chugs med cig 'tshol la rem par zhu// gnas 'khor ba gang skyes bde ba med// las rgyu 'bras kyi nam yang bslu mi srid// dge mi dge'i spang blang zhib mo la// dus da res 'bad pa nan tan zhu// skyabs mi bslu nges pa dkon mchog gsum// tshe 'di phyi bar gsum rtse gcig pa'i// yid dad gus zol med blos 'gel zhing*// las skyid sdug gang gi thag chod zhu// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas gyi rnam grangs kun// zhing gdul bya tha dad kyi snang ngo tsam// rang dad mos gang thob kyi bla ma de// skyabs rgyal ba kun dngos su 307)yid ches zhu// chos grub mtha' sna tshogs kyi nga bzang kun// yul skal ba tha dad kyi rang snang tsam// don zhe phugs byang chub nyid bsgrub la mthun// sems dag snang phyogs med du sbyong bar zhu// 'phral 'di snang bsod nams kyi stobs 'byor dang*// nor longs spyod grogs 'khor dang bde skyid kun// las mngon tho dge 'bras su shes bya la// tshogs rnam gnyis gong 'phel du sog par zhu// 'bangs mnga' ris chab srid kyi skyong bran dang*// srid 'jig rten 'dun thabs kyi bya byed rnams// blo gzur gnas drang tshugs kyi gzhung bsrang ste// kun yid ches nges 'drongs su mdzad par zhu// tshe 'di las phyi ma bsam gal che// 'phral skyid pos phugs don 'grub par dka'// tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub dus 'dir// nam shi yang 'gyod med 'grub mdzad zhu//

kye ma/ bskal dus kyi snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug /rgyal 308)bstan yang nub kha'i nyi ma tsam// sems can gyi bsod nams thur la bri// dam chos la 'bad ran mkhyen par mdzod// rkyen ngan ni bu yug las kyang 'tshub// tshe srog ni rlung seb mar me 'dra// ngan song las skyobs nus dam chos las// thabs gzhan na ma mchis dgongs par mdzod// chos byed rlom mang kyang byed nges dkon// chos sna kha mang pos 'grub par dka'// yid gang la mos pa gcig thog dril// don snying po de kas 'grub pa lags// gros snying gtam glu ru blangs pa 'dis// khyed bzhed don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// tshig mthong thos dran pa'i skye rgu kun// yid dam chos la 'gyur nas smin grol shog/

ces pa 'di ni/ dad stobs 'byor pas mi dman pa'i skal ldan maṅga la'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor bkod pa shu bham// ༈ na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rab 'byams kun// rnam 'gyur gyi sprul pa rgya mtsho yis// ris med 309)du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// khyab bdag gi bla ma spyi bos mchod// khyed dhyā na garbha snying gtam gyi// glu sems la phan pa longs shig skad// bdag rang grol rgan pos shugs 'byung glu// 'di yid la zhog dang bsam gtan pa// dal 'byor 'di dbyar kha'i me tog 'dra// yun ring po mi sdod myur du rgas// khyed rgas kha shi kha'i 'dun ma yi// bsam blo de dam pa'i chos la thongs// tshe srog 'di rlung nang mar me bzhin// nges med du nam 'chi lhus mi things// mthar nam kyang 'chi bar thag chod la// 'gyod med kyi grabs chud myur du rems// lto gos 'di dbul po'i nor rdzas ltar// gcig yod pas mi chog gcig kyang dgos// 'tshol sgrub kyi ngang la mi tshe 'das// chog shes kyi kho thag sems la chod// don med kyi 'jig rten snang shas de// pad tshal du sleb pa'i byis pa bzhin/ 310)/'di yag dang 'di byed ngang la zad// blo kha de nang du khug la shog /dgos med kyi smra brjod chags sdang rgyu// ngag sgrib de zhar dang zhor la gsog /kha ton dang bzlas brjod byed la 'chor// ngag 'khyal 'di nyes pa'i 'byung khungs lags// rgyu 'bras dang dam sdom rtsa ba de// rang sems la g.yo zol med pa dgos// tshul chos dang ngo lkog mkhan po de// btsan dug la lkog zas byed pa 'dra// rnam g.yeng dang gnyid dang snyom las gsum// skom skal du tshwa chu 'thung ba 'dra// ngan goms dang lang la ma shor bar// rang khrims shig rang gis bsdoms dgos so// rnam rtog 'di bkag pas mi khegs kyang*// rjes 'breng dang rang dgar btang ba na// sems 'khrul gyi rta rgod g.yang la 'chor// dran shes kyi bag yod bsten par mdzod// sangs rgyas kyang bla ma'i rnam 'phrul tsam// byin rlabs ni dad

311)pa'i rang gzugs yin// mos gus kyi gdung shugs che chung la// thugs rje yang de dang mthun par 'jug /ci mdzad legs mthong zhig ma byung na// rang blo la mthun dang mi mthun gyi// dad gus de dad pa'i khong rul yin// byin rlabs kyang nam gzhug char pa 'dra// dag snang ni mun pa'i sgron me yin// rang rgyud kyi snang ba ma dag na// log rtog gi mun pa sangs dus med// rang skyon de rang gis brtag nas spang*// dus ngan gyi sems can dug lnga rags// chos byed byed mang la 'grub mkhan nyung*// rang sems kyi mdzub mo sna tser khugs// rang drin de rang la che bar mdzod// snying gtam de sems la ma bcangs na// tshig kha bshad bro pa'i glu dbyangs 'dra// don yid la bsam zhing rgyud la sbyor// glu gdams ngag yin no bsam gtan pa// ༈ a ho/ 'jig rten bya ba 312)blo yi thongs pa dang gcig /gnyis 'dzin the tshom rbad kyi chod pa dang gnyis// 'di phyi'i blo gtad bla mar 'khel ba dang gsum// 'di gsum nus na gtan 'dun 'grub po legs par bsam mno thong*// dag snang mos gus snying rje bskyed pa dang gcig /zhen log dgos med 'chi ba dran pa dang gnyis// sgo gsum dge sbyor brtson 'grus che ba dang gsum// 'di gsum 'bad na thar lam bsnyed do snying rus rgyun du mdzod// rnam rtog ngan lang 'khrul rgyun gcod pa dang gcig /sgom med yengs med rang bab skyong ba dang gnyis// gang shar sems kyi rol par shes pa dang gsum// 'di gsum shes na sangs rgyas 'grub po sems la ma brjed 'tshal// zhes pa 'di ni bsam gtan snying po'i ngor/ 'go dgu dur khrod du'o// dge'o//
